title.narrative: Go-For Expanding space for youth's political participation
Go-For Utöka utrymmet för ungdomars politiska deltagande

description.narrative:
Projektets mål är att utöka utrymmet för politiska ungdomars deltagande i beslutsprocesser i Turkiet. Projektet kommer att genomföras av GoFor i samarbete med LSU of Sweden.
Projektet syftar till att lösa två utvecklingsutmaningar; Avsaknaden av en strukturerad mekanism för politiskt deltagande för ungdomar och icke-inkluderande metoder som hindrar unga människor från att delta.
Att ta itu med dessa frågor syftar till att öka efterfrågan på ungdomars deltagande, förändra deltagandemekanismer och förändra beslutsfattares attityder inkludera ungdomar på lång sikt.

The projects goal is to expand the space for political youth participation in decision­ making processes in Türkiye. The project will be implemented by GoFor in partnership with LSU of Sweden. The project aims to address two problems: the absence of a structured mechanism for youth political participation and non-inclusive practices that prevent young people from participating. Whereby addressing these issues aims to increase the demand of youth participation, transform participation mechanisms, and change decision­makers' attitudes towards including young people in the long term.

The projects goal is to expand the space for political youth participation in decision making processes in Türkiye. The project will be implemented by GoFor in partnership with LSU of Sweden. The project aims to address two problems: the absence of a structured mechanism for youth political participation and non-inclusive practices that prevent young people from participating. Whereby addressing these issues aims to increase the demand of youth participation, transform participation mechanisms, and change decisionmakers' attitudes towards including young people in the long term. The project has identified two main objectives: to strengthen the capacities of youth organizations to increase youth participation in decisionmaking processes to develop relationships with local decisionmakers to mainstream youth rights at the local level

Current PO is retiring. Partner will be sending in an annual report soon and results for current period will be evaluated after the reports are in. A new result different from the previous term results which are stated below is: GoFor's Local Youth Policy has raised a lot of interest from the municipalities therefore in the coming term the partner is expected to work and invest more on the issue.
Previous term results. 1-Strengthened the capacities of youth organisations to increase youth participation in decision making processes,
GoFor has supplied ad-hoc support mechanisms for its member organisations (MO) to build and increase their financial and technical capacity. GoFor is also building a pool of youth experts that supplies mentorship to member organisations on Project Cycle Management and Monitoring and Evaluation, networking and communication etc.
The partner several policy papers in respect of developments on youth developed with their member organisations.
GoFor aims to implement the "Mainstreaming Environment and Climate Change in Youth Organizations" and will be working with LSU on the issue.
GoFor also expanded its reach to the largest number of youth groups to date and increased its media presence, reinforcing its position as a key source of information and resources.
2- Developed and fostered relationships with local decision makers as duty bearers to mainstream youth rights at local levels
GoFor played a pivotal role in enhancing collaboration opportunities with local municipalities by signing protocols with zmir and Antalya Metropolitan Municipalities, which ensured the involvement of GoFor MOs in youth policy-making processes. The organization's "Political Preferences of Youth 2024" research not only gained national attention but also attracted international media coverage, highlighting the position of young people in Türkiye.
In preparation for the local elections, GoFor drafted a youth rights agreement for political party leaders and candidates to sign. These efforts significantly increased GoFor's visibility, elevating it to an important level. This heightened visibility ensured that the youth's agenda became one of the most prominent and widely discussed topics in Türkiye during the election period, amplifying the power and voice of the youth. Additionally, this visibility helped GoFor establish stronger and more effective ties with political party leaders, bureaucrats, and members, ensuring that the youth's voice was heard at the highest political levels.
